Hi, I'm Jodie 👋

Swim teacher. Mum. Jewellery lover. From our home in Darwin.

I'm a swim teacher, so I spend my days in the pool. All day, every day. For years that meant one of two things: no jewellery at all, or taking every ring, chain and pair of earrings off before I got in, then trying to remember where I'd put them.

I got sick of it. And I got sick of cheap pieces that went green or tarnished the minute they touched chlorine.

So my daughter and I went looking for jewellery that could keep up with me. We found bright, fun stainless-steel pieces made to be worn in the water, and they became the jewellery I never take off. Pool, beach, shower, and back again.

The name is us: Jo for me and Tay for my daughter. She's my chief tester, stylist and hand model, and every style gets worn in the water by me before it goes on the site. I pack every order myself, at home.

We keep prices friendly, because jewellery should be fun, not something you're scared to get wet. Thanks for supporting a little Darwin family business. It means the world.

Shower it. Swim it. Love it. 💗
